children: CelcomDigi's 4Q core net profit could grow further sequentially, driven by additional cost savings and higher revenue, CIMB Securities analysts Choong Chen Foong and Kenny Lim say in a note. They tip 2026 core net profit to grow by 7% on year, driven by stronger revenue and Ebitda margin. Earnings could dip 1% in 2027 due to its share of Digital Nasional's losses, partly offset by revenue growth, merger synergies and lower integration costs, they reckon. CelcomDigi also plans to reduce Digital Nasional-related costs through greater infrastructure sharing, improved procurement and operating synergies, they note. CIMB cuts CelcomDigi's target price by 10% to 3.30 ringgit, while maintaining a buy rating. Shares are 2.8% lower at 2.41 ringgit. (yingxian.wong@wsj.com)
